note: Covers only badge/rank/knowledgeCore rewards from missions[].rewards[] — unlock and story rewards are deliberately out of scope, since they're access/narrative flags rather than collectible visual badges (504_JSON_SCHEMA.md's Reward Type distinctions). See generated/images/STYLE_GUIDE.md for the shared icon frame language.

badges.designRationale: A compass rose — the first tool of orientation, matching the very first reward of the campaign.
A folded map with a marked route, echoing Mission 2's sketch-map activity.
A magnifying glass over a footprint, directly referencing Mission 5's investigation.
An open journal — the Explorer's Method is fundamentally about the recording habit Mission 3 establishes.
A telescope and stars, matching Mission 12's observatory and the reveal that the expedition's research reached beyond the station.
Connected data points forming a line graph, matching Mission 13's hidden-pattern discovery.
Layered rock strata, matching Mission 16's geological survey.
First of three escalating rank tiers (1 of 3 chevrons filled) — the reward-arc pattern already noted in CURRENT_TASK.md culminating in Mission 21's Certified Explorer.
Second rank tier (2 of 3 chevrons filled).
Final rank tier (3 of 3 chevrons filled, plus a laurel) — the campaign's culminating reward, deliberately the most elaborate of the three ranks.
